scripts.lighthouse: astro build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('lighthouse',{recursive:true})" && concurrently -k -s first "astro preview --port 4322" "wait-on tcp:4322 && lighthouse http://localhost:4322/ --output=html --output=json --output-path=./lighthouse/report --chrome-flags=\"--headless=new --no-proxy-server\" --view"
